component.summary: Edit tags and cover art on your FLAC and MP3 music files

description.p: MyTag is a simple, focused tag and cover art editor for FLAC and MP3 music files on Linux. Load a single file or a whole folder of albums at once, see everything in a clean list, and edit as many tracks together as you like — MyTag always shows you when the selected tracks disagree on a value, so you never overwrite something by accident.

ul.li: Edit Title, Artist, Album, Album Artist, Year, Genre, Track Number and Disc Number, for one or many files at once (FLAC Vorbis Comments and MP3 ID3v2.4)
Pick a cover image from your computer, paste one from the clipboard, drag and drop it onto the app, or search for one online (MusicBrainz and iTunes) right from the app
Resize covers to any size you choose, keeping their original proportions (or matched to a square when the selected tracks have different covers)
Rename files from their tags with a configurable pattern, preserving original file extensions
Identify an untagged or mislabeled track by audio fingerprint (AcoustID)
Check file stream integrity, and fill in missing covers across a whole loaded library
A per-track indicator flags anything missing a cover, year or genre
Quickly auto-number a set of tracks, or revert unsaved changes back to what's on disk
Search and filter a large list of loaded tracks
Light, dark, or system-matched theme, and an adjustable interface scale
Available in Spanish, English and Catalan
Nothing is written to disk until you choose to save

description.p: MyTag focuses purely on tags and cover art — no playback, no library management, just a clean way to get your audio collection's metadata right.

description.p: Full MP3 audio support alongside FLAC, and typography refinements:

ul.li: Native MP3 audio tagging via ID3v2.4 frames (TIT2, TPE1, TALB, TPE2, TDRC, TCON, TRCK, TPOS).
Embedded APIC cover art support for MP3 (load, replace, resize, and remove).
Audio stream integrity verification for both MP3 and FLAC.
Audio fingerprinting (AcoustID) and automatic tag extraction for MP3 and FLAC.
Extension-aware pattern renaming preserving original format (.flac or .mp3).
Streamlined typography matching native desktop scaling and Nautilus font metrics.

description.p: Major release featuring comprehensive visual modernization and packaging overhaul:

ul.li: Responsive track table layout with a fixed track number column and auto-expanding artist and title columns occupying full panel width.
Pixel-perfect UI alignment with balanced margins, centered cover action buttons, and cohesive visual hierarchy across light and dark themes.
Enhanced dialogs with clear icon-and-label action buttons.
Robust audio fingerprinting pipeline with full 24-bit and multi-channel FLAC decoding via Chromaprint / fpcalc.
Official binary packages for Flatpak, Debian/Ubuntu (.deb), Fedora/RHEL (.rpm), and Arch Linux (.pkg.tar.zst).

description.p: Bug-fix release, plus a first Arch Linux package: drag & drop from external file managers now works on Hyprland and other wlroots compositors, saving after renaming files from tags no longer fails, track list columns can be resized freely and are reordered (Nº, Artist, Title), cover resizing is a directly editable width/height (including a square crop when the selected tracks have different covers), and CSV export was removed.

Context menus on the cover art, a new app icon, a light/dark theme override, an About dialog, a keyboard shortcuts window, drag & drop for cover images, audio fingerprint identification (AcoustID), FLAC integrity checking, batch cover fill-in across an album collection, a per-track completeness indicator, CSV export, and renaming files from tags.
